sys_hub_action_type_definition.description:
Services are the definitions of tasks to run on a swarm. This action returns a list of services from a Docker Instance.

Inputs:

  • Filters - JSON encoded value of the filters (a map[string][ ] string) to process on the services list. Available filters:
    • id - Matches all or part of a service ID. E.g. '{"id":["98ewuw421sl1d5a798qbnrh80"]}'.
    • label - Key value of service label. E.g. '{"label":["test"]}'.
    • name - Matches all or part of a service name. E.g. '{"name":["test-service"]}'.
    • mode - Filters services by mode (global, or replicated). E.g. '{"mode":["global"]}'.

Outputs:

  • Services - Services object containing -
    • ID
    • Version
    • Created At
    • Updated At
    • Spec
    • Endpoint
    • Update Status
    • Service Status
    • Job Status
  • Services List - List of services returned in response as JSON in case of "Success".
  • Status - Will be set to "Success" if the request succeeds or "Error" if a failure occurs.
  • Error Message - Will be populated when the status is "Error".

Error Message:

  • Invalid filter 'filter key'.
  • Filter values provided is invalid or of incorrect format.

Note : User may expect additional error messages based on the API response.

Additional Note:

  • If any of the provided Filters input does not exist, the API returns "Status:Success" and "Services List:[ ]".

To use this action, the corresponding Docker connection and credential must be created and associated with the Docker Connection & Credential alias.Learn More

Note: Requires a subscription for production use. Read More.
sys_hub_action_type_definition.name: Look up Services
